messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street and slowly walks forward, with the camera gradually moving closer to her back.","camera":"A rear, slightly low-angle tracking shot that follows the character from behind and slowly dollies in toward her upper back.","clothing":"She wears a matching plaid two-piece outfit in beige, brown, and orange-red, consisting of a long-sleeved collared jacket with a back belt and slim trousers, plus dark shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair is pulled up into a high top-knot bun with a few loose strands at the nape.","identity":"A female-presenting 3D character with a slim build, seen from behind with her face not visible.","scene":"A hazy, overcast old European-style street with red-brick buildings, shop awnings, a Union Jack flag on the left, and a cobblestone road."},"uncertain":["The character's face and exact identity are not visible since she is shown from behind.","Whether the shoes are fully visible is unclear as they are partly cut off in later frames."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunny waterfront promenade to a foggy cobblestone street with red-brick buildings, shop awnings, street lamps, and a Union Jack flag, closely matching the reference. The character remains seen from behind in the same plaid outfit and high bun, walking forward while the camera slowly dollies in from a rear low angle.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside background with the reference image's hazy old European street, while keeping the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: The character's face and expression are not visible from the rear view, so exact expression preservation cannot be verified.
unexpected_changes: The overall lighting became flatter and hazier to match the new overcast street, reducing the previous strong sunlight and long shadows.
